text:
rachel_marketing: Hey team — prepping launch post and need a paired replication run with runtime for the headline bench numbers. Can someone from runtime pair with us this week? Want to validate methodology + artifacts before press.
sam_runtime: @rachel_marketing I can take point. Quick Q — do you want coldstart-only or a full warmup sweep + coldstart tail? :thinking:
rachel_marketing: Prefer both. Marketing wants the coldstart percentiles for the claim, but engineering asked for warmup vs steady-state deltas. Need a reproducible pack for the press kit.
lee_runtime: We should capture: seed, payload list, batch config, quantization flag, and exact model git sha. Also trace logs for a sample of requests. Can you share the payload cohort?
jordan_data: Uploading a minimal cohort now to GCS -> gs://redwood-marketing/launch-cohorts/replication-v1.json (contains 500 queries, stratified by length).
olivia_growth: Also include the embed/rerank path sample — we quote embed latency separately. Can we get both text-gen and embed runs? :+1:
sam_runtime: Yep. Plan:
1) Run n=3 full sweeps (warmup + steady) on unlocked staging capacity (quantized + fp16 variants)
2) Run n=5 coldstart-only single-shot sims with the same payloads
3) Collect p50/p90/p95/p99, token counts, and per-token cost calc
4) Export traces for 50 random requests per run
Command we'll use:
```
./bench-run --cohort gs://redwood-marketing/launch-cohorts/replication-v1.json \
  --model-revision 2026-03-18-sha1abcd --warmup 10 --samples 500 \
  --variants fp16 quantized --out gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v1/
```
rachel_marketing: Perfect. Two asks: (A) Put a short README in the output bucket listing the exact CLI flags and runtime config we used (helps audit), (B) include a CSV of request->trace id mapping so we can attach sample outputs in the press pack.
lee_runtime: Will do. Also: do you need the raw logits or just generated text? Raw logits are large and will need secure bucket.
jordan_data: For marketing claims we only need generated text + deterministic seed mapping. Research might want logits later; we can gate that with security team.
olivia_growth: Timeline? Marketing wants draft PR by EOD Wednesday to sync with comms calendar.
sam_runtime: Running first sweep tomorrow morning. Expect artifacts by Tue 16:00 PST. If we hit any variance we'll rerun with tighter RNG seed.
benchbot: Scheduled run queued: job_id=rb-20260323-77, expected duration ~3h per sweep. Notifying on completion.
rachel_marketing: Amazing — please ping here with the bucket link and a 1-paragraph note about any divergences from expected perf. I'll draft the launch paragraph once we have the numbers. :rocket:
lee_runtime: Quick note — we'll also include heatmap of latency by token position (helps explain tail cases). If you want a simplified chart for the press deck say so.
olivia_growth: Yes please — simplified chart w/ p50/p95 lines. Keep raw axis units ms.
sam_runtime: Copy. Will attach chart + raw CSVs. If marketing needs a shorter blurb about methodology I can draft a 2-sentence explainer.
rachel_marketing: That would be super helpful. Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, escalate to eng-requests channel and tag @sam_runtime.
benchbot: job_id=rb-20260323-77 completed successfully. outputs: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v1/run-20260323-77/overview.json
sam_runtime: Uploading README + csv mapping now. Link in 2m.
sam_runtime: README: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v1/run-20260323-77/README.md
sam_runtime: CSV mapping: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v1/run-20260323-77/request_trace_map.csv
rachel_marketing: Received — reviewing now. If numbers look same as our draft claim we'll proceed to PR. Thanks all :heart:
